{{#ev:youtube|6yuk7Ukzzjc|300|right|An overview of skills|frame}}

'''Gems''' are a type of [[item]] that grants a [[skill]] ([[skill gem]]) or modifies a [[item socket#links|linked]] skill ([[support gem]]) when socketed into a corresponding [[socket]] in a piece of equipment. The character needs to have the required [[level]] and [[attribute]]s specified on the gem to socket it. There are currently {{Drop enabled gem count|where =items.class_id="Active Skill Gem"}} different [[skill gem]]s and {{Drop enabled gem count|where =items.class_id="Support Skill Gem"}} [[support gem]]s in the game, for a total of {{Drop enabled gem count}}. 

__TOC__

==Gem types==
===Skill Gems===
{{main|Skill gem}}
Skill gems grant various types of skills that can be used by the player. For a list of skill gems, see [[List of skill gems excluding vaal skills]].

====Tranfigured Gems====
{{main|Transfigured gem}}
Most skill gems have one or more alternate versions called Transfigured Gems (denoted by having "{{c|gem|of X}}" as a [[suffix]]) to the default gem that alters their function and balance.

====Trathan gems====
{{main|Trarthan gem}}
Trathan gems are another alternate versions of skill gems (denoted by having "{{c|gem|of Trarthus}}" as a [[suffix]]).

====Vaal Skill Gems====
{{main|Vaal skill}}
Vaal skill gems are special versions of skill gems that grant both the regular version of the skill and a Vaal version, which consumes Souls gained from killing monsters or dealing damage to bosses to use a significantly stronger but temporary version of the regular skill. Vaal skill gems can be identified by the orange-red details in the inventory art compared to the typical yellow-gold. For a list of vaal skill gems, read [[List of skill gems granting vaal skills]]

===Support Gems===
{{main|Support gem}}
Support gems modify supported skill gems in various ways, increasing their damage or providing different effects. For a list of support gems, see [[List of support gems]]. Only a single copy of each support gem can affect a skill. The highest level support gem is prioritized.

==Exceptional Gems==
{{main|Exceptional gem}}
Exceptional gems are special gems can only be obtained from specific endgame bosses or encounters. The {{il|Originator Voidstone}} socketed must be socketed in your [[Atlas]] in order for them to drop. Most exceptional gems are support gems, with a few of them being active gems (Ex. [[Pact]] skills). Some of them provide numerically or mechanically stronger versions of their regular support gem counterparts, and some provide unique effects. Note that most [[Exceptional support gem]]s belonging to the first category cannot stack with their non-Exceptional variant.

==Gem levels==
===Experience===
[[Image:gem experience bar.png|thumb|upright|When a gem is close to levelling up, a bar pops up at the right hand side of the screen, showing the experience progress of that gem.]]

* Socketed gems gain 10% of the experience your character earns, before any level penalties. This value is not affected by level penalties.
* The number of gems you have equipped has no effect on the rate of experience gain.
* Gems do not lose experience when you die.
* Items that affect experience gain (e.g. {{il|The Supreme Truth}} do affect gem experience indirectly.
* Gems socketed in inactive weapon slots ([[weapon swap]] or disabled items) gain experience and can be levelled up, as long as the requirements are met.
* Gems can be traded like other items and will retain their experience.

Once a gem has enough experience to level up, it will stop gaining experience and a level-up icon will appear on the right of the screen and in the inventory menu. Left-clicking it will level up the gem, and a button to level up all gems will appear if multiple gems are capable of doing so. Right-clicking the icon instead will lock the gem's level, hiding it from the main screen and preventing the gem from gaining any further levels or experience. Players may choose not to level up certain gems to their maximum for various reasons, such as decreasing the threshold to proc {{il|Cast when Damage Taken Support}}, or lowering the [[mana]] cost or [[attribute]] requirements of certain skills. Gems that have their levels locked and hidden can be viewed in the player's inventory screen below their inventory slots; right-clicking the lock icon will level up the gem but keep it locked, while shift-right-clicking it will unlock it instead.

As gems level up, their stats increase and may gain additional effects, but the level and attribute requirements to use them also increase, as well as their cost in most cases. If a gem gains enough experience to level up, but the exile currently does not meet the requirements, the level–up icon will appear greyed out and not be useable until the requirements are met. For specifics, see the lists of [[#Active Skills|active skills]] and [[#Support Gems|support gems]] below.

[[Facetor's Lens]] and the respective option of the [[Divine Font]] that grant experience to a gem automatically levels up gems to prevent wasting experience. The "Increase level of non-Corrupted Awakened Gem by 1" [[Beastcrafting|Beastcraft]], on the other hand, will discard any excess experience.

====Items that alter experience gain====

|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=

    AND items.class_id != "Map"
|large=1

===Level cap===


Each gem has a level cap which once reached will no longer gain experience. For most gems, this cap is Level 20. Corrupting a gem also has a chance to raise a gem's current level by 1, up to 1 above the level cap. Various items and stats can increase the effective level of the gem, however, to a maximum of level 40.

For example, gems can be modified by local or global modifiers to gem level, such as {{Ml|LocalIncreaseSocketedGemLevel1|display=verbose}} and {{Ml|GlobalSkillGemLevel1|display=verbose}} or their more specific variations, [[Corrupted|corruption implicit modifiers]], or unique items such as {{il|Dialla's Malefaction}} and {{il|Ashes of the Stars}}. They can also be linked with the support gems that increase level such as {{il|Empower Support}}, {{il|Awakened Empower Support}}, or certain awakened gems at level 5+ ({{il|Awakened Added Fire Damage Support}}, {{il|Awakened Added Cold Damage Support}}, {{il|Awakened Added Lightning Damage Support}}, {{il|Awakened Added Chaos Damage Support}}, {{il|Awakened Elemental Focus Support}}, {{il|Awakened Burning Damage Support}}, {{il|Awakened Void Manipulation Support}}, {{il|Awakened Minion Damage Support}}, {{il|Awakened Blasphemy Support}}, and {{il|Awakened Generosity Support}}). Additional levels from sources outside of the gem itself do not affect the attribute and level requirements for the gem.

==Quality==
A {{il|Gemcutter's Prism}} can be used to upgrade a gem's [[quality]]. Adding quality to a gem will add an additional effect to the skill. The exact modifications quality gives to the gem are displayed in the detailed view (hover over the item and hold Alt).

When a red, green, or blue gem is socketed to a [[gem socket]] of the same colour, the gem gains an additional +10% to quality.

The quality effects scale with each percentage of quality. However, many effects have certain breakpoints to have a practical impact on the quality effect. Non-integer values are usually rounded down. For example, {{c|gem|3% quality}} on a gem with {{c|mod|0.5% increased damage}} will only grant {{c|mod|1% increased damage}}, '''not''' 1.5%. Refer to individual gem pages for specific details about these breakpoints.

===Related unique items===

    item_stats.id LIKE "%gem%quality%"
    AND items.class_id != "Map"

}}

|stat_text =1
}}

==Corruption==
Like most items, gems can be [[corrupted]] using a {{il|Vaal Orb}}. Corruption on gems can potentially lift the level or quality percentage of a gem above the maximum of 20. Corruption can also convert a gem into its [[Vaal skill]] equivalent, if one exists. It's suggested that you apply Corruption to a Skill Gem when the Skill gem is at level 20, 20% quality or both in order for corruption to potentially exceed the cap.

After the release of [[Incursion league]], it became possible to achieve "double-corruption" of a gem by using the [[Lapidary Lens]] device in [[The Temple of Atzoatl]]. The device corrupts a skill or a support gem twice, which makes possible to apply two different effects of corruption at once. This allows to receive a level 21 gem with 23% quality.

==Obtaining gems==
There are several methods of obtaining gems:
* Random item drops in all areas.
* Offered as a quest reward (see [[List of gems rewarded from quests]]).
* Purchased from certain town [[vendor]]s after completing quests (see [[List of gems rewarded from quests]]).
** Vendors in Acts 1-4 towns sell gems which scale up in gem level based on the player's level, up to approximately a level requirement of 50-54. The available gems are based on the character's class and quest progression.
** [[Siosa]] in Act 3 ([[The Library]]) sells all gems at gem level 1 that have a required level of 31 or lower, excluding {{il|Detonate Mines}}.
** [[Lilly Roth]] in Act 6, Act 10, the [[Epilogue]], or your [[hideout]] sells all gems except {{il|Empower}}, {{il|Enhance}}, {{il|Enlighten}}, and {{il|Portal}} at gem level 1 after completing the Act 6 quest {{ql|Fallen from Grace}}.
* Vendor recipes (see [[vendor recipe system]]).
* As a reward for turning certain sets of [[divination card]]s.
* Through Gem Reward chests and icons in various mechanics.
* [[Beastcrafting]] recipes.
* [[Betrayal Safehouse]] rewards.
* [[Vaal gem]]s can be obtained from Vaal Vessels in [[Vaal side areas]], corrupted map bosses, and various other sources.
* [[Transfigured gem]]s are obtained from the [[Divine Font]] in [[the Labyrinth]].
* [[Trarthan gem]]s drop exclusively from [[Mercenary|mercenaries]].
* [[Exceptional gem]]s drop from specific endgame bosses.

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.27.0|
* When multiple Gems are able to be levelled up, there is now a button available that can be clicked to level them all up at once.
* Gems that have their levels manually locked now have better protection for accidental level ups, requiring you to shift click to level it up or shift right click to unlock it.{{Undocumented}}
* Skill Gems traded to other players via the trade window now have their 'Level Up Dismissed' and 'Attack In Place' properties reset.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.23.0|
* [[Alternate quality]] [[gem]]s, [[labyrinth enchantment|labyrinth helmet enchantments]] and [[Threshold jewel|unique threshold jewels]] are all systems that were trying to subtly modify the behaviour of [[skill]]s. With this expansion these have been combined into a new system called [[Transfigured Gem]]s that allows us to fully achieve the goal of these three systems, and then some.
* Transfigured Gems are alternate versions of existing skill gems that have different functionality and balance than their regular versions. We have added many of these, with interesting variations that drastically change how existing skills play.
* Some existing skill gems have had stats or interactions removed from the base gem and moved to the Transfigured versions to provide more focused support for pre-existing alternate playstyles.
* A substantial amount of damage-dealing skills have had their quality stats buffed. In most cases they will be significantly more powerful than before, and also more interesting. Many supports have also received changes to their quality stats.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.22.0|
* Updated [[Skill Gem]] item hovers to indicate when the maximum augmented level is reached (it's level 40).
}}
{{Version history table row|0.8.6|
* Tidied up the gem [[attribute]] requirements display.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.8.5|
* Fixed a bug where a gem could outlevel the player.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.8.0|
* Gems now have level requirements in addition to attribute requirements.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
